program_text: program 11 FREN - French French Language and Culture COA_French Language and Culture Go Back Print Certificate of Achievement (COA) French Language and Culture New Online Option Noncredit New for Spring 2026 Program Description Pending state approval. Please check with the CTE Division Office for status. The Certificate of Achievement in French Language and Culture is designed to offer students the opportunity to discover another culture and to help Francophile students broaden theirs. It is also suitable for students with French links. The certificate enables students to engage with the growing French-speaking communities in the Bay Area and to travel, study, work or get involved with businesses in 29 different countries. The certificate will satisfy a language transfer requirement and could be used in graduate work across multiple fields such as anthropology, art, history and linguistics. Program Learning Outcomes Upon completion, students will be able to Communicate and express basic opinions about abstract topics Enable production of discourse level writing related to personal experiences Demonstrate an understanding of the cultures and histories of French-speaking peoples and countries Engage critically with socially constructed cultural and social distinctions examined through the lens of students’ own cultural learnings and backgrounds De Anza College Requirements Noncredit Certificate Requirements Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a C grade, passing grade or satisfactory progress Each course must be completed at De Anza College Skills Certificate Requirements Skills Certificates are awarded by departments and are not notated on official college transcripts. Contact the department directly for assistance in applying for a skills certificate. Completion of all major courses with a C grade or higher Each course must be completed at De Anza College Certificate of Achievement Requirements Certificates of Achievement are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. No more than six quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements Certificates of Achievement-Advanced are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. Students must demonstrate proficiency in English and Mathematics by qualifying for ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H or ESL 5, and by qualifying for MATH 114 or a transfer-level Math course No more than 18 quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements See Cal-GETC pattern found at deanza.edu/articulation/ge-requirements . Note: This is an exception to the Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements. The requirements are stated within the description. Associate Degrees (A.A. or A.S.) Requirements Proficiencies Students must demonstrate proficiency in reading, written expression and mathematics.
